dialogues.speaker: Semino
dialogues.text: Music is the language of the soul.

dialogues.speaker: Semino
dialogues.text: ...Mm, communicating is tough, but I'm sure the Wayob can see things my way.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there a language barrier of sorts?

dialogues.speaker: Semino
dialogues.text: Ah... Well, communicating across languages requires a little more time and effort, yeah.

dialogues.speaker: Semino
dialogues.text: After all, each instrument has its own character.

dialogues.speaker: Semino
dialogues.text: Calm, mellow, lively, and those that love to steal the show. Finding a stage where they can coexist in harmony is tough stuff.

dialogues.speaker: Semino
dialogues.text: The Iridescence Tour is what's got my eye right now. If I had a chance to talk with the organizers, I'm sure we'd have a fruitful time!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll help you ask the Wayob when I get the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Semino
dialogues.text: Really, you'd do that for me? There's no need. I was just kidding!
